UNIVERSITY OF IBADAN
FACULTY OF SCIENCE, DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE
CSC 312: OPERATING SYSTEMS
SECOND SEMESTER EXAMINATION, 2025/2026 SESSION
TIME ALLOWED: 3 HOURS

INSTRUCTIONS: Answer QUESTION ONE and any THREE others.

1a. Define a critical section. State the three requirements any solution to
    the critical section problem must satisfy.                      (9 marks)
1b. A system has four processes and three identical resources. Determine
    whether deadlock is possible. Justify your answer.              (8 marks)
1c. Distinguish between preemptive and non preemptive scheduling.   (8 marks)

2a. Explain demand paging. Describe what happens on a page fault.   (10 marks)
2b. Given the reference string 7 0 1 2 0 3 0 4 2 3 0 3 2 and three frames,
    compute the number of page faults under FIFO and under LRU.     (15 marks)

3a. Describe the producer consumer problem and give a semaphore solution.
                                                                    (15 marks)
3b. What is a race condition? Give one example from a file system.  (10 marks)

4a. Compare contiguous, linked and indexed file allocation.         (12 marks)
4b. Explain the purpose of an inode.                                (13 marks)

5a. Describe the banker's algorithm and state its main limitation.  (15 marks)
5b. Explain thrashing and how the working set model addresses it.   (10 marks)
